beats.text: The rural population in the Netherlands is shrinking by 6.6%. In Oman, it's growing by 3.8%.
This counts everyone in areas outside cities, calculated as total population minus urban population.
Big countries diverge. India is growing by 0.4%, while Brazil is down 2%.
The fastest growing countrysides climb steeply: Niger at 2.8%, Saudi Arabia at 3.6%, and Syria at 3.7%.
At the very top is Oman, expanding by 3.8%.
Is the countryside growing or shrinking in your country?
